description.value: Viti Wine and Lager is a specialty liquor retailer in downtown Vancouver, part of a five-location Greater Vancouver chain under the Viaggio Hospitality group. The downtown Seymour Street shop carries over 500 wines, 300 craft beers, and 160 spirits, with a notable emphasis on exclusive Okanagan BC wines and local craft beer. Delivery is available through major apps, and custom orders can be arranged for events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is the downtown Vancouver location of a multi-location specialty liquor store chain at 900 Seymour Street, with phone 604.683.3806 matching OSM exactly. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags beyond wheelchair=yes (not confirmed via website). The store sells packaged alcohol products only — no food, takeout meals, or cyclist-specific services are evident.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Sa 10:00-23:00) omits Sunday hours and slightly misrepresents the downtown location's actual hours per website; website is authoritative.
This is one of five chain locations; other locations (Hastings, Broadway, New Westminster, Nordel) may exist as separate OSM nodes and should be checked for duplicates.
